caption: The drawing depicts a woman in profile view facing right, dressed in a long, elaborate gown. The gown is primarily a soft pink color with a plaid pattern and features multiple layers of white lace ruffles on the skirt, sleeves, and collar. The skirt extends into a long train at the back, with the lace forming three distinct horizontal tiers. There is a large pink bow at the back of the waist, with additional panels of fabric draping down over the skirt's lace. The sleeves are elbow-length with large lace ruffles at the cuffs and elbow area. The high collar is also adorned with thick white lace. The woman has light brown, wavy hair styled into a low bun at the back of her head. She is wearing pink shoes with black details. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist's signature, "Edith Taunu," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doll: "Carrie"
